title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: std feature build broken (8 compile errors in std_ext)
description:
std feature build is broken with 8 compile errors:

1. FragmentReceiver::rule_id field is Option<u8> but initialized with 0 (not None), compared with == 0 (not .is_none()), assigned u8 directly (not Some()), and passed to Ack::new() as bare u8
2. Ack::new() called with &Vec<bool> bitmap instead of u64 at lines 1174, 1190, 1217 — the bitmap_to_u64 conversion was removed but callers weren't updated
3. FragmentSender::fragments_in_window() method doesn't exist; fragments_in_window_vec calls it but the method was removed (line 1014)

To fix:
- Change rule_id from Option<u8> to u8 (matching the usage pattern), with 0 as sentinel
- Re-add bitmap_to_u64() conversion or change Ack::new() to accept &[bool]
- Make fragments_in_window_vec use an iterator directly instead of the missing method

Affected: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs std_ext module (lines ~1014, 1045, 1118-1121, 1172, 1190, 1215)
